title: feat(pm): the relay appends a sealed, signed note to an unpublished advisory's description — advisory_note
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg9B4P8sYYpTKQsrzFX3biHd)_
domain:skills#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaqHXh17Qc3C7MRAQw

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：中继新增一行 `advisory_note`：席位把一段分析在本进程里封给中继的公钥，中继在 runner 上解封，只追加到 triage、draft 或 closed 公告正文的末尾，再逐字节读回确认。
- 为什么改：裁定的分析不能公开，此前只能在会话里转交；现在可以私密地留在公告本身，首行是席位签名，第二行是门自己打的 UTC 时间。
- 风险与回滚：明文不进载荷、Actions 日志、仓库文件或 step 输出；`note_file` 须在任何 git 仓之外（按 realpath 判，符号链接也算），否则席位门不读即拒；原正文逐字节不变；两次读之间正文被改即拒写；published 与 withdrawn 拒。按裁定 B 私钥是仓库 secret（有写权者都能读到，一旦泄露可解开过去的密文）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ops.mjs` 新头注节「The one row that APPENDS to an advisory」与 `advisory_note` 行；`execute.mjs` 的 `advisoryNoteAction`；`fleet-write.yml` 执行步新增的一行 env。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --self-test`，预期 417 例 / 21 组、366 例 / 28 组、382 例 / 31 组全过。
- 需要你做的：① 钥对你已造好，公钥已提交为 `ADVISORY_NOTE_RELAY_PUBLIC_KEY`（`b57ecb50`）；仍归你的只有私钥那半：仓库 secret `OS_FLEET_ADVISORY_NOTE_KEY`（你说已设好；座位读不到 Actions secret，首笔一次性试写即是读数）；② 审阅并批准（`fleet-write.yml` 按路径为 Tier H）。契约复核 PASS：首轮 6815013623，复审 6815807297，第三轮（公钥）6818354267，`Head-sha: 68a1f68f2630edf24736ce34a121292fe77017ba`；席位记录 6818377284。

Fixes #32424

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `git grep -n -i -c -E "advisory_note|OS_FLEET_ADVISORY_NOTE_KEY|security-advisories" -- 'skills/**' 'content/docs/**'` has no hit (exit 1)
Maintainer-action: the X25519 pair is made and its public half is committed as `ADVISORY_NOTE_RELAY_PUBLIC_KEY` (`b57ecb50`, handed over by the maintainer on 2026-11-12). Only the private half stays the maintainer's: the repository secret `OS_FLEET_ADVISORY_NOTE_KEY`, set from that same pair without printing it (`openssl base64 -A -in note.key | gh secret set OS_FLEET_ADVISORY_NOTE_KEY --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`), then `note.key` deleted. The maintainer reports it set; no seat can read an Actions secret, so the first live stroke is the reading: no secret, or one from another pair, is refused before any request. Ruling of record 6813624778 (B, repository secret). The first live stroke is a throwaway note: read that run's public log for the note's text before any real note goes out.

## What changes

A new relay row, `advisory_note` — `ghsa_id` and `sealed_note`, alone in its stroke, `repository-advisories: write`, the stroke's own target-write sender gate. It appends one dated, signed section to an unpublished advisory's `description` and never rewrites what is there. The section's text is sealed end to end: from the seat's process to the runner's executor step, and from there only into the PATCH body.

- `ops.mjs`: the row and a new field kind, `sealed`. The seal is shared with the read's: X25519, HKDF-SHA256 and AES-256-GCM, with its own HKDF label (`fleet-write:advisory_note:v1`). A note never opens as a read, and a read never opens as a note. The associated data binds the request id, the action index, the op and the advisory id. The committed relay half is `ADVISORY_NOTE_RELAY_PUBLIC_KEY`, the maintainer's public half; a null one (kept as a guard, its tests inject it) is a prerequisite at the seat and a refusal at the executor. Also new:
  - the key judge, `advisoryNoteKeyFailure`;
  - the fences: a 2xx, the advisory named, state `triage`, `draft` or `closed`, and a description that is text or null;
  - the composition: the text read, byte for byte, then `\n\n---\n\n`, then the section;
  - the read-back, which tells a raced write apart from one that is not stored;
  - the keyed digest.

  A new header section records the order 「立卡处理 给 relay 加一个"改 advisory 正文"的操作（长期办法）」, the ruling 「B」, the executor's eight steps and the residual window.
- `validate.mjs`: a `sealed` value is judged by shape alone: its length, canonical base64url and version byte. It is never echoed and never opened, because the validator holds no key. `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` gains `advisory_note=yes` for a note's stroke, and an empty value for every other stroke.
- `fleet-write.yml`: the execute step's env gains ONE line, `FLEET_WRITE_ADVISORY_NOTE_KEY: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.advisory_note == 'yes' && secrets.OS_FLEET_ADVISORY_NOTE_KEY || '' }}`. Every other stroke's step gets an empty value. The header says so.
- `execute.mjs`, `advisoryNoteAction`, in this order:
  1. Judge the key against the committed half, before any request.
  2. A fenced GET.
  3. Open the note.
  4. Judge the section again; the seat's check is never trusted alone.
  5. Hand every line of 6 or more characters to `::add-mask::`, except a line that occurs in the note's own notice, so the landed notice still parses. The runner never echoes the command.
  6. A second fenced GET immediately before the write. A changed description is refused.
  7. The cap: 65,535 code points.
  8. ONE PATCH of `{ description }`.
  9. Read back the PATCH's answer, then a GET after it, each byte for byte.

  It reads the key once and deletes it from its own environment. A landed note emits ONE notice: the action, the section's byte count and its HMAC-SHA256 under a one-time digest key that only the seat holds. A refusal quotes the platform only in its listed messages.
- `dispatch.mjs`: reads the note from the file `note_file` names, at the seat. The file must lie outside every git repository: its real path (`realpath`, so a symlink is judged where it points) is placed with `git rev-parse`, discovery's steering variables removed. A file inside a work tree or git dir, or one git cannot place, is refused before it is read. It composes the section:
  1. the file's first line, which must be the seat's signature line;
  2. this door's own UTC stamp (a typed stamp is refused);
  3. a blank line;
  4. the rest.

  It judges the section, draws a one-time digest key and seals both under the stroke's request id, before the packer and the dry-run exit. The action leaves carrying the seal alone. After a `success` run, the run's notice is confirmed against the count and digest this process holds. Anything else is `unverified`, exit 6, and never re-sent. `--json` gains `advisory_notes`.
- `references/security-findings.md` §3 and `references/lanes/security.md` each gain one line naming the row and where the note file lives (outside every git repository), with the seat's signature first and the ruling record cited when one exists. Both are paid in-file: two bullets merged in each, so both files hold their ceilings.

## Tests

- `validate.mjs --self-test`: new battery `advisory_note: …` (22 cases, battery floor 20 → 21). It covers:
  - the row, its field and its one bodiless PATCH;
  - the caps, with the largest note's payload under 64 KiB;
  - the values refused and never echoed: plaintext in the key, short, long, padded, another version, a number, `note_file` or `note` beside the seal, and alone violations;
  - the grant and `advisory_note=yes` versus empty on three other ops;
  - the workflow pin: ONE live line names the key, in the execute step, behind the validator's output, with no artifact or cache step;
  - the seal opening byte for byte for its own request, action, advisory and key, and never as a read;
  - key reasons, fences, composition, read-back and the keyed digest.
- `execute.mjs --self-test`: new battery `advisory_note: …` (25 cases, floor 27 → 28), over a fake API with a synthetic relay pair. It covers:
  - landed: GET, GET, PATCH, GET, with the PATCH body exactly the text read plus the separator and the section, including CJK, an emoji, a quote and a backslash;
  - an empty description;
  - four key failures with zero requests after the sender gate;
  - seven first-read fences with zero writes;
  - four open failures;
  - three re-judged sections;
  - the mask registered only after the re-judge, and a note whose lines equal the notice's own words landing with a notice that still parses;
  - the race;
  - the cap, exact and one over;
  - PATCH 403, 422 (quoting the note) and threw;
  - three read-back failures;
  - five payload refusals;
  - THE MARKER TEST across every run's log, transcript, step summary, rows, annotations and pace lines. The marker is checked as text, URI-encoded, hex and base64, together with the relay key;
  - the real validator and executor processes, with the key in the environment.
- `dispatch.mjs --self-test`: new battery `advisory_note at the seat: …` (22 cases, floor 30 → 31). It covers:
  - the stamp, the section and its refusals;
  - the arm, whose seal opens for this request only, with the payload holding no plaintext and no path;
  - a fresh digest key per arm;
  - five file refusals, and a null key (injected) as a prerequisite judged after the file; the committed half pinned to one X25519 public key;
  - a note file inside a git repository refused before it is read: this checkout, a symlink into it, and another clone; git absent, an unread answer or a probe that throws refused as unplaceable;
  - the notice spelling and the confirm;
  - END TO END with the real executor's notice confirmed;
  - four unverified runs;
  - the CLI's dry run, `--json`, the prerequisite and the usage refusal, with no line carrying the note;
  - a structural pin on where `main` seals.

## Acceptance notes

- Deviation from the analysis's "Prints lengths and SHA-256 digests only": the public digest is HMAC-SHA256 under a one-time key the seat draws and seals inside the note. A bare SHA-256 of a short note would let any reader of the public run test a guess.
- Deviation, by widening: the executor re-judges the whole section, not only its signature line. That covers the signature, the stamp, the blank line, a non-blank body and no control characters.
- NOT MEASURED, by design: platform-side request logs, and what the advisory page itself shows. Also not measured: a live stroke. The secret is the maintainer's word, and the first live stroke's key judge and byte read-back are that measurement.
- Residual window, as analysed: the REST description declares no conditional write on this endpoint (no `If-Match` or `If-Unmodified-Since`; read 2026-11-12). A write that lands between the second GET and the PATCH is overwritten undetected, about one round trip. A write after the PATCH is caught by the read-back, FAILED and never re-sent.
- The cap counts code points: the description's `maxLength` 65535, read 2026-11-12. How the platform counts it is not measured live.
- The recorded cost of B stands: every write-holder can read the secret, and a key read once opens every past ciphertext.
- Tier: `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: `fleet-write.yml` is Tier H by path. The maintainer merges.
- No changeset: repo scripts, one workflow and agent reference files, none of which any package's `files` ships (`skip-changeset`).
- Left as is: the mask net rests on the runner not echoing `::add-mask::`, and the self-test sweeps an injected sink, not the CLI's own stdout. Only a live run shows the runner's log, so the first live stroke is a throwaway (Maintainer-action).
- Left as is: the residual window is one round trip only when the pacer has nothing to wait for, because `rest` paces the PATCH after the second read. A note is alone in its stroke on a fresh runner, so its pace log holds no earlier write.
- Left as is: the read-back does not re-judge the advisory's state, so a publish inside the window still reports a landed note. The row prints the state the GET after the PATCH read, so such a publish shows there.
- Left as is: nothing stops the same run executing twice, and a re-run appends again. Every relay row shares this class, so the guard belongs on a follow-up card, not in one row. filed #32571 (with the delta review's nit on the door's unanchored match of git's answer)
- Left as is: the signature line and the stamp are the seat's attestations; the executor checks their shape only, and a separator inside the body is not refused. This is the trust model of every seat post.

## Verification

Head `68a1f68f`: the public key `b57ecb50` merged with `origin/main` `3452dec2`, no rebase. The merge brought nothing under `scripts/pm/**`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` or `fleet-write.yml`. The earlier rounds: `f75b7895` (contract review 6815013623), delta review 6815807297 on `f646f4e3`.

<details><summary>Self-tests on the final head</summary>

- `validate.mjs --self-test`: 417 cases pass across 21 batteries.
- `execute.mjs --self-test`: 366 cases pass across 28 batteries.
- `dispatch.mjs --self-test`: 382 cases pass across 31 batteries.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot, red, then restored)</summary>

Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on a committed head: the first four on the first round's work, the next two on `f75b7895`, the last on `b57ecb50`. Each went red, and the tool restored the blob to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty.

- `execute.mjs`, the second read's description-equality check disabled: 2 of 364 failed. The raced description was overwritten and only the read-back caught it.
- `execute.mjs`, the mask call removed: 3 of 364 failed.
- `fleet-write.yml`, the key handed to every stroke (the validator's `advisory_note == 'yes'` condition dropped): validate 1 of 417 failed.
- `dispatch.mjs`, the seat's count-and-digest comparison disabled: 2 of 380 failed. The other seal's notice was confirmed.
- `dispatch.mjs`, the door's refusal of a file not placed outside every repository disabled: 2 of 382 failed (head `f75b7895`): the inside-a-repository case and the unplaceable case.
- `execute.mjs`, the mask's exemption for the note's own notice removed: 2 of 366 failed (head `f75b7895`): the landed note with notice words in it, and the `advisoryNoteMaskValues` unit case.
- `ops.mjs`, the committed public key set back to null: validate 1 of 417 and dispatch 1 of 382 failed (head `b57ecb50`), the two pins on the committed half.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `68a1f68f`: 60 commands, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe. All 60 exited 0.
- `--ran`: 60 derived, 60 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the four scripts: exit 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`:
  - `security-findings.md`: 65 lines, ceiling 65.
  - `lanes/security.md`: 53 lines, ceiling 53.
  - The two rule lines are 117 bytes each.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`: 113 files clean.
- `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: `fleet-write.yml` is Tier H by path. 1441 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold.
- Control-byte scan of the seven files: no hit.
- After the merge, `origin/main` moved 4 more commits; none touches `scripts/pm/**`, `fleet-write.yml` or the two reference files.

</details>
